tests.title: Exit 0 utan verifiering
tests.specification:
**Grind:** R1. **Krav:** REQ04, REQ22. **Status:** passed (local Windows evidence).

**Givet:** Agenten avslutar med exit 0 men inga acceptanstester har körts.

**När:** Körningen avslutas.

**Godkänt endast om:** execution_status=succeeded men task_status=awaiting_review. Aldrig verifierat klar.

**Gäller:** always.

acceptanceEvidence.environment: Windows x64, Node 22.18.0, npm 11.7.0, Chromium via Playwright
acceptanceEvidence.command: npm run verify; npm run smoke
acceptanceEvidence.result: Passed: a real offline child process exits zero in an isolated Git worktree through authenticated HTTP dispatch of an exact task revision. The run exposes executionStatus=succeeded while its task remains awaiting_review, with no independent verification or human acceptance. The original checkout is unchanged and reopening the profile preserves the states. Browser fixtures at 1536/390 pixels show explicit review and the separate process/task outcome.
acceptanceEvidence.scope: Local real-process/SQLite/API scenario plus explicit DEMO browser rendering. No real provider/model, OS-sandbox, criterion acceptance or pilot claim.

tests.title: Fel commit i testbevis
tests.specification:
**Grind:** R1. **Krav:** REQ04, REQ16. **Status:** passed (local Windows evidence).

**Givet:** Tester har passerat på commit A och koden ändras till B.

**När:** Godkännande eller färdigmarkering begärs.

**Godkänt endast om:** Beviset betraktas som utdaterat. Nya kontroller eller explicit dokumenterat undantag krävs.

**Gäller:** always.

acceptanceEvidence.environment: Windows x64, Node 22.18.0, npm 11.7.0, Chromium via Playwright
acceptanceEvidence.command: npm run verify; npm run smoke
acceptanceEvidence.result: Passed: real npm verification on commit A followed by committed B refuses task acceptance of the old proof and clears its verification. Binary changes in a leading-space filename also invalidate it. Exact required/optional criterion decisions, verification ID, task versions and result are bound to one-time task.accept approval; changed notes, swapped evidence and another operation are refused. Acceptance/revision/approval writes roll back together. Correction or reverification invalidates recorded task acceptance; a changed dependency blocks the next process before spawn. Profile reopen and prior-schema migration preserve history without inventing task acceptance.
acceptanceEvidence.scope: Local Git/npm/SQLite and authenticated HTTP, plus explicit DEMO desktop/mobile criterion review and stale-evidence rendering. No real provider, exception waiver, OS-sandbox, continuous filesystem monitoring or full R1-R4 claim.

acceptanceEvidence.environment: Windows x64, Node 22.18.0, npm 11.7.0, Chromium via Playwright
acceptanceEvidence.command: npm run verify; npm run smoke
acceptanceEvidence.result: Passed: real SQLite and authenticated HTTP reject a cyclic dependency with its named path. The complete plan and revision history remain unchanged, including after profile reopen. Real browser create/edit flows at 1536/390 pixels display the cycle and verify unchanged API state. Multi-hop and cross-project dependency cycles are also rejected.
acceptanceEvidence.scope: Local planning dependency transaction and desktop/mobile browser scenario with synthetic content. No provider, pilot, offline-device, task-execution or criterion-acceptance claim.

acceptanceEvidence.environment: Windows x64, Node 22.18.0, npm 11.7.0, locally compiled .NET Framework process host
acceptanceEvidence.result: Passed: real runner and Codex adapter against a local protocol fixture. **När:** Återuppta projekt, lämna avgränsat uppdrag och följa upp från mobilen provas där stöd finns.

**Godkänt endast om:** Skillnader, manuella steg och luckor dokumenteras. Fortsätt endast de ADO-delar som ger verkligt mervärde. Frånvarande funktion räknas inte som provad.

**Gäller:** always.

tests.title: Begränsat skal- och responstest
tests.specification:
**Grind:** R4. **Krav:** REQ24, REQ22. **Status:** not_run.

**Givet:** 50 repo-metadataobjekt och 10 000 historiska events används på dokumenterad referensmaskin med warm lokal databas.

**När:** Cached startsida öppnas och 30 definierade UI-handlingar genomförs utan externa API-latenser.

**Godkänt endast om:** Föreslaget mål: första användbara lokala vy under 2 s och lokal återkoppling p95 under 200 ms. Ingen obunden logg-/minnestillväxt vid upprepning. Riktiga mätvärden och miljö bifogas.

**Gäller:** always.
